nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Micropoint for Dark Spot Patches

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed outcomes: some describe red circles, scarring, or irritation from the adhesive or micropoints, while one with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports no irritation at all.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report visible fading of age spots and sun spots with continued use.
segments.combination: An olive-toned, easily-marked reviewer describes lasting discoloration after overnight wear and warns against use on easily marked skin.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers used the patches on dark spots from old pimples, sun, or melasma and report gradual fading over days to weeks, often needing several applications and more patches than come in a pack; a substantial minority saw no change at all despite following instructions.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with active or past acne (including cystic acne) report the patches fade post-acne marks and shrink scarring over one to three weeks; a few say the patches did nothing for their blemish-related marks.
concerns.aging: One 70-year-old reviewer reports the patches worked well on age spots; a Hero regular in her 40s with Asian skin also reports visible fading of age-related dark spots.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness and inflammation after pimples, with faster visible recovery; others, especially those with sensitive skin, report the patches themselves caused a red ring or red circle lasting one to two days.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the patch's hyaluronic acid content helped the treated area avoid dryness during treatment; no other barrier-related comments appear.

extraits.texte: I don't have tones of breakouts I'm 35 but I use sunscreen when I go running and sometimes if I don't wash my face right after my run I will get a blemish. I had one blemish and figured these patches would be a good spot solution. I left it on overnight and unfortunately it discolored my skin. I washed my face and the discoloration did not go away. It's been about two days and you can still see it. I will not be using these again. It did not state on the package this was a possibility. If you have ever had laser hair removal and had spot discoloration this is what it looks like. I consider myself olive tone, not sure if this product works for all skin tones or if you should not have sun exposure or what, but my skin is easily marked (by the sun with sun spots, etc) if you have sensitive skin, please don't buy. Also, the blemish spot did not change color just the skin around it where the patch covered....

Be careful if you have sensitive skin—the outer part of the patch has left a red circle on my face for two days now. I will say it helped to fade my dark spot in just one use, but not worth the reaction it gave me :') sucks because I've liked every other product from this brand

These patches do work! I'm in my early 40's and have Asian genes. Any Asian knows that our skin is very sensitive and unfortunately we develop dark spots early and easily. I've tried many products but this one has really shown results! I could tell after two tries my spots were fading. The dark spots will never completely disappear. However they have faded enough that an acquaintance commented my skin looked more even. There are only two things I would change. One, they need to make them in larger sizes and two, there needs to be more patches in the box.

I've had stubborn upper lip melasma for about a year now -- which always become worse when I've been out in the sun. I've tried so many skin lightening creams, peels, and pills. I bought this on a whim and after one usage of all patches in the pack on my upper lip they seem to have been a real dent in my melasma after I thought nothing could. I just bought three packs more because I think I'll need a few rounds to hopefully get rid of my melasma. But I'm excited because it's the first affordable treatment that seems to have made a difference. Hero folks - I'd love if you'd make this in a larger patch that could cover a full upper lip (or I imagine some people may want their whole side of the cheek, etc.) - putting a bunch of the circles down doesn't really cover the whole thing and I imagine will need thoughtful placement as I continue to use them. But anyways, I'm happy -- I'm hopeful about my melasma erasure after continued use of this product.

This product did wonders for my skin! I compulsively pick at my skin, which results in countless acne scars and dark spots. After using the Micropoint for Dark Spots patches, my dark spots and scars are basically invisible. I have sensitive, acne prone skin, and I never had any irritation from this product whatsoever. If you feel discouraged because your dark spots won't go away, try this product. I used to feel like my dark spots would be on my face forever, but this product gave me visible results. I swear by it!

As someone with cystic acne, these are a staple for my skin when it's healing from a breakout and I'm left with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. I can see the difference after constant use. My dark spots are much lighter after a week or two. When I'm not using these patches I also use the lightning wand. Both are great for dark spots! I order hero cosmetic products about once a month and the shipping is always super fast!

I am a light to medium skinned person. These are kind of like a Band-Aid where there's a center (that goes on dark spot) and the adhesive part around it that actually sticks to your skin. The adhesive part actually created a light circle on my face, but did nothing for the actual dark spot. Weird and annoying!
